played_utterance.context: Seina asks if Kabuto attempted to get Shiki blood or other tissue. Player Shiki affirms requested, but he refused and gave no voluntary specimen; no other disclosure.

events.event: Seina visibly relieved at no voluntary sample handover, warns possible non-consensual samples from discarded hair, blood, tools or prior treatment are only a theoretical risk, not established. She vows confidentiality of Shiki's reply, plans audit of medical records access and own staff.

Seina audits four requests for old unusual tissue-response records; 3 correctly issued, 4th under legacy project with paper issuance code K-17 as external medical consultant, 5 weeks before Konoha exam. Request subject neuroconduction and controlled modification tissue sensitivity; not definitive Shiki records or proof K-17 is Kabuto. Izumi begins tracing authorized consultant and access.

Izumi determines authorization was signed using credentials of former medical program director who no longer held post then, possible forgery. Before they can interview him he is found dead at home without visible wounds; initial cause possibly arrhythmia, unproven murder. Tose expresses concern second archival link harmed. Izumi insists calling it death until evidence of murder, and refuses to turn Shiki into bait for unknown adversary.

Tose reviews mission outcome report: 'Успешно. Свидетель спасён. Вещественные доказательства сохранены'. Old biological-research archive and unlawful access, Minagi kidnapping established. Kabuto Yakushi named in one old external medical request, direct kidnapping participation unproved, no identification of K-17. Izumi keeps broader investigation open into funding, suggests Shiki's assignment finished unless directly relevant new findings. Tose currently in Kusa office, Shiki not in scene; no unwritten player action or decisions.

continuity.shiki: Chunin of Kusa, promoted Aug23; statement to Seina that Kabuto requested sample but Shiki gave none is explicit canon. Secret shared only with Seina, not automatically transmitted to Tose/Izumi.
continuity.seina: Medical mentor, aware of sample refusal and worried about unauthorized access, not proven sample theft. Might exercise medical confidentiality.
continuity.tose: Kusa team leader, knows investigation report and optional wider Kabuto link but not details Shiki-Seina privately discussed.
continuity.izumi: Special jonin, competent and cautious, case open, wants identify research funder. Did not establish K-17 identity or kill cause.
continuity.minagi: Witness recovered enough to testify, injured but alive; no new medical developments established.
continuity.kabuto: Not confirmed recipient of any Shiki biological specimen, role in post 6 kidnapping and fake group unresolved.

last_scene: Kusa operation office. Izumi tells Tose current mission closed but broader investigation continues, she will notify if anything directly affecting Shiki discovered. Shiki not present; player control intact.
